title: O Trinity of Blessed Light
altTitles: Thou Who Art Three in Unity
author: Ambrose of Milan (340-397)
credit: Ambrose of Milan, 4th Century.  German version by M. Luther, 1543.
verses: The fiery sun now goes his way;
Shed Thou within our hearts a ray.
To Thee our morning song of praise,
To Thee our evening prayer we raise;
O grant us with Thy saints on high
All laud to God the Father be,
All praise, eternal Son, to Thee,
All glory, as is ever meet,
